title: Brooklyn Dispensary for Tourists & Hotel Guests | BUZZY
description: Visiting Brooklyn? BUZZY is a licensed cannabis dispensary in Cobble Hill near Brooklyn Heights and Downtown Brooklyn. See what you need to shop and visit us at 137 Court Street.

blocks.html: BUZZY is a licensed cannabis dispensary in Cobble Hill, Brooklyn, welcoming New Yorkers and visitors alike. Whether you’re staying nearby, visiting for the weekend, or exploring the borough, we’re here to make shopping simple.
• 21+ with a valid government-issued photo ID. No New York residency required.

blocks.text: Stay in. We’ll come to you.

Long flight, late check-in, or a view you don’t want to leave? Order from the full BUZZY menu and our own drivers will bring it to you, with live tracking from our door to yours. We deliver to ZIP codes 11201, 11215, 11217 and 11231. Have your photo ID ready: you must be 21+ and the person who placed the order.

blocks.text: Visiting from somewhere else? Here’s how it works here.

blocks.html: Cannabis is legal in New York for adults 21 and over, and visitors are welcome to shop at licensed dispensaries. Here’s what to know before you stop by.
You must be 21 or older with a valid government-issued photo ID. You do not need to be a New York resident.
New York has a regulated cannabis market. Shop with licensed dispensaries like BUZZY so you know what you’re getting.
Dispensaries can’t take credit cards. We accept cash and debit, and there’s an ATM in the store if you need one.

blocks.text: Know how much you can buy

blocks.html: Adults can legally purchase and carry up to 3 ounces of cannabis flower or 24 grams of concentrated cannabis at any one time.
Hotels and private properties set their own smoking and cannabis policies. Check the rules wherever you’re staying before using cannabis.
Cannabis can’t legally cross state lines, even if it’s legal where you’re headed. Plan to enjoy your purchase while you’re in New York.

blocks.text: The Brooklyn dispensary where locals shop.

blocks.html: BUZZY is locally owned and led by a minority and woman-owned team with deep roots in cannabis and in Brooklyn. It’s where the neighborhood actually shops: a tight, carefully chosen menu and people who know it inside out.

Cobble Hill is one of Brooklyn’s most walkable neighborhoods, surrounded by restaurants, shops, brownstone-lined streets and some of the borough’s best-known neighborhoods. BUZZY is just a short walk from Brooklyn Heights, Boerum Hill and Downtown Brooklyn.
Make an afternoon of it: stroll Court and Smith Streets for shops and food, unwind in Cobble Hill Park, or walk to Brooklyn Bridge Park for waterfront views.

items.title: Can tourists buy cannabis in New York?
items.html: Yes. Adults 21 and older can purchase cannabis from licensed New York dispensaries with a valid government-issued photo ID. You don’t need to be a New York resident.

items.title: Do I need a medical card to shop at BUZZY?
items.html: No. BUZZY is an adult-use cannabis dispensary for customers 21+.

items.title: What ID do I need to buy cannabis in New York?
items.html: Bring a valid government-issued photo ID showing that you are 21 or older.

items.title: Can I bring cannabis home after my trip?
items.html: Cannabis cannot legally be transported across state lines, even when traveling between states where adult-use cannabis is legal.

items.title: Can I use cannabis in my hotel?
items.html: Hotels and property owners set their own policies. Check with your hotel or accommodation before smoking, vaping or otherwise consuming cannabis on the property.

items.title: Where is BUZZY in Brooklyn?
items.html: BUZZY is located at 137 Court Street in Cobble Hill, close to Brooklyn Heights, Downtown Brooklyn, Boerum Hill and Carroll Gardens.
